expected_before_evaluation.witness: u (tied exactly with 2*D, because u * 2D = m and T_minus(x) = T_minus(m/x); the smaller is u)
expected_before_evaluation.bin_fields_from_bin_by_status: bin NEAR_FLOOR, bin_at_least NEAR_FLOOR, boundary_flag false
expected_before_evaluation.why: T_minus(u) = T_minus(2D) = sqrt(2D) + sqrt(u), and 2u lies within a factor 1 + 2^-37 of D, so T_minus(u) is about (sqrt 2 + 1/sqrt 2) sqrt(D) = 2.1213 sqrt(D) against the real minimum 2 m^(1/4) of about 2 sqrt(D); e - F is about log2(1.0607)/log2(r_M) < 0.09/255, while C - F exceeds 62/log2(r_M); so the witnessed depth exceeds 0.99 > 3/4 + tau and is not within tau of 1/4 or 3/4. Every other member of W is at distance at least 2^60 from sqrt(m) in ratio.
